summary: Vars plugins inject variables that don't come from inventory, playbooks or the command line. host_vars and group_vars are implemented by the shipped host_group_vars plugin. Vars plugins were partly added in 2.0 and fully reworked in 2.4.
questions: How does Ansible load host_vars and group_vars directories?

answer_card.title: What vars plugins are
answer_card.answer_md: Vars plugins add variable data from sources other than inventory, playbooks or the CLI. The `host_vars` and `group_vars` directories are read by the shipped `host_group_vars` vars plugin. They have been fully implemented since Ansible 2.4.
